newsitem.title: EU: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, July 1 - Friday, July 11.
newsitem.headline: Reuter European Court of Justice Diary for Tuesday, July 1 - Friday, July 11.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, JULY 1

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-85/96 Martinez Sala: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 7, paragraph 2 of Council regulation 1612/68, of October 15, 1968, on freedom of movement for workers within the community as well as articles 2 and 4, paragraph 1(h), of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Notion of "salaried worker" - Person who has been unemployed for years and who depends on welfare. Notion of "family services". Educational allowance paid to a parent with no professional activity in order to care for a young child (Erziehungsgeld).

SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-125/96 Simon: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Commission regulation 1546/88 of June 3, 1988, on procedures for supplementary contributions addressed in article 5c of regulation 804/68. A posteriori fixing of a complementary payment after an insufficient declaration. Payment deadline and interests on lateness.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-62/96 Commission v/ Greece: free movement of persons. Non respect - EC treaty articles 6, 48, 52, 59 and 221. Conditions for granting the right to fly the Swiss flag on boats from other member states. - (1015/0815 GMT) Oral procedure joined cases C-253/96, C-254/96, C-255/96, C-256/96, C-257/96, C-258/96 Kampelmann: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 2 and 9, paragraph 2 of Council directive 91/533 of October 14, 1991, on the employer's obligation to inform a worker of conditions applicable to a contract or job. Obligation to indicate the title, grade or category of work for which the worker is engaged. Effects of the information supplied by the employer on the burden of proof regarding the worker's job status. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-366/96 Cordelle: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Compatibility of a national overlapping benefits law with EC regulations. Overlap of a Belgian subsistence benefit with a French old age pension paid on the basis of a working life and augmented owing to child-bearing, job history and with a child-raising supplement.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-184/96 Commission v/ France: free movement of goods. Non respect. EC treaty article 30. National regulation on foie gras-based preparations not guaranteeing mutual recognition of products from other member states.
WEDNESDAY, JULY 2

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-157/96 National Farmers' Union: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Commission decision 96/239 of March 27, 1996, on certain emergency measures on protection against bovine spongiform encephalopathy. Commission powers - principle of proportionality. - Oral procedure C-180/96 United Kingdom v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of Commission decision 96/239 of March 27, 1996, on certain emergency measures on protection against bovine spongiform encephalopathy. Commission powers - scope - principle of proportionality.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment T-28/96 Chew v/ Commission: status of officials. Case reserved for officials. - Oral procedure T-172/96 Chevalier-Delanoue v/ Council: status of officials. Case reserved for officials.
THURSDAY, JULY 3

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure C-80/96 Quelle Schickedanz: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of annex 6 of Commission regulation 1966/94 of July 28, 1994, on the classification of certain goods in the combined nomenclature. Classification in two different positions of a matching set consisting of a bra and underpants, presented for retail sale. Interpretation of general rule 3 b as it affects the interpretation of the combined nomenclature.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-97/96 Daihatsu Deutschland: company law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6 of Council directive 68/151/EEC: first counsel directive of March 9, 1968, on coordination of safeguards which, for the protection and the interests of members and others, are required by Member States of companies within the meaning of the second paragraph of Article 58 of the Treaty, with a view to making such safeguards equivalent throughout the Community. Sanctions against companies who fail to publish their annual accounts. Direct application of the directive. - Oral procedure C-92/96 Commission v/ Spain: environment and consumers. Non respect. Article 4 of Council directive 76/160/EEC of December 8, 1975, on the quality of bathing water. Failure to take necessary measures to meet required interior bathing water standards. - (1530/1330 GMT) Oral procedure C-7/95 P John Deere v/ Commission: competition. Appeal against Court judgment (second chamber), rendered October 27, 1994, in case T-35/92 John Deere v/ Commission. Decision 92/157 on application procedure for EC treaty article 85. Agreement on exchanging information on agricultural tractor registrations. - (1615/1415 GMT) Oral procedure C-8/95 P New Holland Ford v/ commission: competition. Appeal against Court judgment (second chamber) rendered October 27, 1994, in case T-34/94, joined cases Fiatagri and Ford New Holland v/ Commission. Commission decision 92/157 on an application procedure for EC treaty article 85. Agreement on exchanging information on agricultural tractor registrations.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment C-269/95 Benincasa: judicial competence convention/execution of decisions. Interpretation of articles 13, paragraph 1, 14, paragraph 1 and 17, paragraph 1 of the Brussels Convention - Competency in matters of consumer contracts. Notion of consumer. Prorogation of competency. - Judgment C-330/95 Goldsmiths: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 11, part C, point 1 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Reduction in case of partial non payment. Power of a member state to provide for a reduction in the assessment basis where the goods are a sum of money, but to exclude such reductions in other cases. - Judgment C-60/96 Commission v/ France: taxation. Non respect. Breach of article 2 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Granting of a VAT exemption on the leasing of certain movable property such as tents, caravans and mobile homes. 271505 OVR:BC-DIARY-COURT =2 Reuter European Court of Justice Diary (page 2/2) - Opinion C-177/96 Banque Indosuez: ECSC. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Commission decision 2131/88 on a definitive anti-dumping duty on imports of certain iron and steel sheeting from "Yugoslavia". Meaning of term after the secession Macadonia (FYROM) and in particular between May 1 and July 21, 1 9 92. - Oral procedure C-192/96 Beside: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 259/93 of February 1, 1993, on the surveillance and control of waste transports in and out of the EC. Notion of "urban waste" and "household waste", annex III - Rights and obligations of competent authorities in sending and receiving states in cases of the illegal traffic of wastes. Interpretation of Council directive 75/442/EEC of July 15, 1975 on waste. Notion of storage with a view to the processing provided for in annex II B. - Oral procedure C-203/96 Dusseldorp: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 34, 86, 90 and 130. Interpretation of Council regulation 259/93, of February 1, 1993, on the surveillance and control of waste transports in and out of the EC and of Council directive 75/442/EEC of July 15, 1975 on waste as amended by Council directive 91/156/EEC. National regulations on wastes to be used or eliminated and which reserves a company's exclusive right to incinerate wastes when foreign reprocessing is inferior or equivalent.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Oral procedure T-101/96 Wolf v/ Commission: status of officials. Case reserved for officials. - Oral procedure T-223/95 Ronchi v/ Commission: status of officials. Case reserved for officials.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR MONDAY-FRIDAY, JULY 7-11
MONDAY, JULY 7

TUESDAY, JULY 8

COURT OF JUSTICE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Opinion C-338/95 Wiener: free movement of goods.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0730 GMT) - Judgment joined cases C-94/95, C-95/95 Bonifaci: social policy. - Judgment joined cases C-248/95, C-249/95 SAM Schiffahrt: transport. - Judgment C-261/95 Palmisani: principles of community law. - Judgment C-373/95 Maso: social policy. - Opinion C-57/96 Meints: free movement of persons. - Oral procedure C-163/96 Raso: free movement of persons.
